title: Bp Genomics RNA Extraction
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Gather consumables and hardware
steps.instruction: Collect all listed consumables and equipment: Opentrons OT‑2 robot, OT‑2 Run App (Version 3.15.0 or later), Magnetic Module, P20 single‑channel pipette, P1000 single‑channel pipette, compatible tips, NEST 96‑well PCR plate, NEST 12‑well reservoir (15 mL) or Opentrons 24‑tuberack with 2 mL tubes, NEST deep‑well plate (1 mL), and NEST 1‑well reservoir (195 mL).

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Open the OT‑2 Run App and input the required protocol parameters for the pureBASE RNA extraction, including the addition of 4 µL internal extraction control RNA as described in the 2019‑nCoV Detection Assay protocol.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Click the download button in the OT‑2 Run App to save the generated protocol script to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: In the OT‑2 Run App, use the Upload function to load the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Place the labware on the robot deck as follows: Slot 1 – NEST 96‑well PCR plate (for elutes); Slot 2 – NEST 12‑well reservoir (15 mL) **or** Opentrons 24‑tuberack with 2 mL tubes; also load the NEST deep‑well plate (1 mL) and NEST 1‑well reservoir (195 mL) in appropriate slots as indicated by the deck map.

steps.title: Load pipettes and tips
steps.instruction: Mount the P20 single‑channel pipette and the P1000 single‑channel pipette on the OT‑2, and load the corresponding tip racks.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2 Run App, perform calibration of all labware, tip racks, and both pipettes according to the on‑screen instructions.

steps.title: Execute the RNA extraction
steps.instruction: Press ‘Run’ in the OT‑2 Run App; the robot will execute the pureBASE RNA extraction, automatically adding 4 µL internal extraction control RNA at the appropriate step.
